claims.population: Jalingo is estimated at 418,000 residents as of 2018 and about 581,000 as of November 2022.
claims.climate: Jalingo has a tropical savanna climate (Koppen Aw) with a cloudy wet season and a partly cloudy dry season; the clearer season starts around 30 October and ends around 6 March.
claims.seat: Jalingo is the seat of the Muri Emirate and the capital of Taraba State.
